title: Telemetry trace event
description: One dispatch-envelope observation emitted by the loadout telemetry emitter. Wraps a validated envelope-in or envelope-out payload (see envelope-in.json / envelope-out.json) with the event kind and emission timestamp. A sink receives a stream of these records — one per envelope handoff during an invocation's lifecycle. additionalProperties:false, mechanical whitelist.

kind.description: envelope_in: dispatch start, the inbound envelope the caller constructed. envelope_out: dispatch exit, the outbound envelope the agent returned.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the emitter recorded this event.

envelope.description: The validated envelope payload (matches envelope-in.json or envelope-out.json depending on kind). Carried as an opaque object at this layer — the emitter does not re-embed the envelope schema, it trusts the caller already validated it via clagentic_loadout.envelope before emitting.
